reason: role_gated. The USD0 book (USD0 token, DaoCollateral, SwapperEngine, bUSD0, USD0a) has no anyone-callable function that pays the caller: everything callable moves the caller's own funds and the fees run caller->treasury. The only keeper-class functions (USD0a harvest, bUSD0 sweepFees) revert NotAuthorized from a fresh address, and harvest has never been called since USD0a deployment. Complements the closed redemption lead 153 (UIP-12 replaced the USD0++ fee mechanism).
